paragraphs: Rabbi Shimon, son of Rabbi Hillel ben Pazi.

His father, Rabbi Hillel, was a student of Rabbi Assi, as at the beginning of Ketubot chapter 9. Shimon was his father’s student, as in Sanhedrin, chapter 7, halakhah 5, where he asks him a question.[^1][^2]

notes.text: רפ״ט is the ordinary abbreviation for the beginning of chapter 9. Shimon asks his father; the phrase is singular, not “they asked.”

The checked Ketubot 9:1 passage has Rabbi Hillel bar Pazi asking Rabbi Yosei, beside Hyman’s Rabbi Assi. Sanhedrin 7:5 explicitly names Rabbi Shimon, son of Rabbi Hillel ben Pazi, asking Hillel. Hyman’s teacher conclusions are retained as his interpretation; the differing question recipient is not silently repaired or used to establish a new teacher relationship.
